payout_quote: Get a $100 reward for each friend you refer! Once your friend opens an account and sets up online banking, you both get $100 deposited into your checking. You can earn up to $300 per year. Upon verification that all Qualifying Actions have been completed within the required timeframes, each the Referrer and Referee will receive a $100 reward, delivered via email within four weeks. Referrers may earn up to $300 in rewards per calendar year, based on a maximum of three valid referrals.
steps: Generate your unique referral link from the Alabama Credit Union referral page using the email on your account.
Send the link to friends and family and submit their email through the official referral process.
Your friend opens a new Alabama Credit Union checking account (Value or Lifestyle Checking) and enrolls in online banking.
The friend keeps the checking account open for at least 45 calendar days.
After verification, you each receive $100 deposited into your checking, within 4 weeks.
catches: Referrer may earn up to $300 per calendar year based on a maximum of three valid referrals.
Referee must keep the new checking account open at least 45 calendar days.
Referrer must be an existing member in good standing with at least $5 in primary savings and a valid email on file.
Referee must be 18+ and use the email submitted through the official referral process; youth and business accounts do not qualify.
Referee must open a primary savings account ($5 minimum) plus a Value or Lifestyle Checking account and enroll in online banking.
$100 reward is delivered via email within 4 weeks after verification.
Promotional offer is subject to change or termination at any time.
biggest_catch: Referrer cap is three referrals ($300) per calendar year; the new checking account must stay open 45 days; referral must go through the official process with the referee's email submitted in advance.
eligibility: Referrer must be an existing Alabama Credit Union member in good standing with $5 minimum in a primary savings account and a valid email on file; referee must be 18+ and eligible for membership.
timing: Referral share takes ~5-15 minutes active; $100 deposited to both parties' checking within 4 weeks after verification of all qualifying actions.
weasel_words: subject to change or termination at any time
